title: On $k$-limited domination in graphs
summary: In this work, we introduce and study the notion of $k$-limited domination in graphs, motivated by applications where dominating vertices have bounded capacity and cannot be overloaded by too many external neighbors. Formally, given an integer $k \le Δ(G)$, a set of vertices $D \subseteq V(G)$ is called a $k$-limited dominating set if it is a dominating set and, in addition, each vertex of $D$ has at most $k$ neighbors outside $D$.
